caption: The drawing depicts two brown and tan animals, a cow and a calf, standing on a greenish, rectangular base. The cow is shown in profile facing left, with visible ribs, and has a predominantly brown body with tan accents around the head, underbelly, legs, and tail area. The legs and hooves are mostly dark gray or black. The calf is positioned underneath the cow, oriented with its head at the cow’s udder, as if nursing. The calf is also mostly brown with some lighter tan on its legs and underside, and has similarly colored hooves. Both animals have a painted texture, suggesting either modeled or sculpted forms. The background is plain and uncolored, and underneath the image, the name "ISABELLA RUTH DOERFLER" is printed in uppercase letters.
title: Cow and Calf Toy
